question: Why do all appear fearless while resorting to the single body of the pair seen as beneficial?
premises: They resort to a single body.
That body belongs to a pair seen as beneficial.
inference: By taking refuge in the unified beneficial pair, all attain a state that appears fearless.
uncertainties: The identity of the 'beneficial pair' is not specified.
plain_english: All, as if fearless, resort to the single body of the pair seen as beneficial.
